title: Bios & Updates
body: Read outreach stories, stay informed through our newsletters, and see how Veteran John Outreach is serving throughout the year.

blocks.title: Featured Story
blocks.subtitle: Real people. Real stories. A brighter tomorrow.

deck.title: More Than a Meal
deck.subtitle: For James, a warm meal was just the beginning. What started as a simple conversation at a community outreach even became a turning point -- a reminder that he is not forgotten, and that a brighter tommorw is possible.

blocks.title: More Stories
blocks.subtitle: Additional stories from our outreach in the community.

deck.title: Walking Together Through Winter
deck.subtitle: As temperatures dropped, our team hit the streets to provide warm clothing, essential supplies, and encouragement to individuals experiencing homelessness. This story highlights the power of community and what's possible when we show up.
